destination.name: Levuka
destination.tagline: Fiji's first capital, a World Heritage colonial port town on Ovalau island
destination.description: Levuka is a colonial port town on the east coast of Ovalau, Fiji's first capital and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Visitors climb 199 steps from the Methodist church to Mission Hill's old mission houses for a view over the reef and offshore islands, or hike to the peak above town for the outlook across the Koro Sea. The Levuka Community Centre, a restored 1878 trading store, holds a branch of the Fiji Museum and the town museum. Coral cays such as Leleuvia lie about 45 minutes away by boat, and a guided hike reaches Lovoni village inside Ovalau's volcanic crater.
whyVisit: Climb above town for reef views

goodToKnow.title: Lovoni is a guided visit
goodToKnow.detail: Lovoni village is reached on a guided hike with a village tour and a Fijian lunch, from about FJD 120 a person for two guests.

goodToKnow.title: Museum and tourist information
goodToKnow.detail: The Fiji Museum branch and the town museum share the Levuka Community Centre with the library and a tourist information booth.

goodToKnow.title: Check cay access first
goodToKnow.detail: Leleuvia is about 45 minutes by boat. Caqalai's resort says it is closed until further notice, so confirm access before planning.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Visit in {months} for hikes up the peak and boat trips to the cays. Cyclones can occur Nov to Apr.

levuka-1.bio: Hike up the 199 steps to Mission Hill for old mission houses and a view over the offshore islands and reef.

levuka-4.bio: Village in the middle of Ovalau's volcanic crater, visited on a guided hike with a village tour and a Fijian lunch.

levuka-5.bio: Small coral cay about 45 minutes by boat from Levuka, with a beach, snorkelling off the shore and day trips.
